article.title: Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis: Psychological Interventions for Posttraumatic Stress Disorder in Internally Displaced and Refugee Youth.
article.authors: Schreyer B, Ertl V, Rosner R
article.journal: J Am Acad Child Adolesc Psychiatry
article.abstract: Refugee and internally displaced children and adolescents experience high rates of post-traumatic stress symptoms (PTSS). Yet there is a lack of evidence of the effectiveness of psychological interventions in this population. This systematic review and meta-analysis investigates the effects of psychological interventions on PTSS among refugee and internally displaced children and adolescents (PROSPERO CRD[masked]).
